releases.title: Tattoo Review Reality Series Expands to 4 Platforms Across Charlotte
releases.body:
Tattoo Review, now filming at Tattoo Factory of Charlotte, the newest addition to The Tattoo Factory chain of tattoo shops. The studio is located at 5237 Albemarle Road, Suite 106, Charlotte, NC 28212. More information is available at tattoofactoryofcharlotte.com.

CHARLOTTE, N.C., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KAOZ TV LLC and City View Films have transitioned the reality series Tattoo Review into a full-length episodic format, documenting the daily operations of Tattoo Factory of Charlotte. Moving beyond the limitations of micro-content, the series provides an authentic look at professional body art culture, prioritizing artist-client collaboration over staged competition formats. The new show will include piercings as well as tattoos.

Prospective clients and viewers can access studio updates and service information at https://tattoofactoryofcharlotte.com

The expanded series explores the technical and personal narratives found within a high-volume studio. A primary differentiator in the new format is the inclusion of both tattoos and professional piercing services, offering a comprehensive view of the body art industry. Each episode tracks the progression from initial consultation and design to the final procedure, providing a practical resource for first-time clients and a behind-the-scenes look for enthusiasts. By focusing on the day-to-day pace of a working North Carolina studio, the production highlights the reality of the client experience.

"We are presenting the authentic, unfiltered energy of our new Charlotte tattoo studio to a wider audience through Tattoo Review," said Derek Van Cleve, owner of Tattoo Factory of Charlotte. "By moving away from staged competition tropes and focusing on the genuine connection between our artists and their clients, we are offering viewers a rare look at the dedication behind every tattoo and piercing."

Multi-platform distribution

To ensure broad accessibility, the series utilizes a strategic distribution network:

  • Digital & Social: Viewers can access content via YouTube and Facebook, with additional streaming availability on KLIPZ TV.
  • Broadcast Syndication: Full-length episodes are syndicated on KAOZ TV, connecting the production with both the local North Carolina market and a national audience.

This multi-channel approach allows viewers to engage with the series through their preferred medium, whether on social media, streaming devices, or traditional television.

releases.title: AARP New York Launches 'Staycation' Campaign To Help New Yorkers Explore More, Spend Less
releases.body:
Free events, day trips, classes and downloadable postcards highlight affordable experiences across New York

NEW YORK, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- When rising costs put travel and entertainment further out of reach for many New Yorkers 50+ and their families, AARP New York looked closer to home. From higher utility bills to the growing costs of caregiving, many households are watching every dollar. 

Through the Staycation and New York Experiences campaigns, AARP New York is connecting people with opportunities to get out, learn something new and experience more of what the state has to offer this fall, from day trips and cultural attractions to classes and community events. The campaign also features free downloadable postcards showcasing New York City's five boroughs, upstate destinations, and historic sites, highlighting New York's history and heritage during the nation's 250th anniversary.

"There's nothing quite like the experience of being a New Yorker," said Beth Finkel, AARP New York State Director. "At a time when New Yorkers are watching every dollar, whether they're managing higher utility bills, rising everyday expenses, or the financial demands of caring for a loved one, we wanted to showcase great experiences right in our own backyard. This is about more than finding affordable things to do. It's about connecting with one another, creating memories, and making the most of the communities we call home."

"The Staycation campaign is a great invitation to rediscover New York. It highlights the incredible range of experiences available across the state, from community events and cultural attractions to lifelong learning opportunities, and encourages people to explore places and activities they may never have considered before," said AARP volunteer Teri Hatred of Islip. "My all-time favorite free night out is AARP's Movies Turning 50. All an AARP member needs to do is register themselves and guests for the movie(s) of their choice to receive a free ticket, popcorn and soda! This year we have Taxi Driver in September, Carrie in October, A Star is Born in November and Network in December. Four free nights out to enjoy classic films."

People Magazine dubbed 2026 "Staycation Summer," citing a Monster survey that found:

  • 52% of workers said rising living costs led them to stay home more often this summer
  • 39% said they cut back on vacations or trips
  • 37% said they looked for lower-cost leisure activities

The financial pressures extend beyond travel. Family caregivers often take on additional transportation, medical, household, and day-to-day expenses while caring for a parent, spouse or other loved ones.

At the same time, rising utility costs are putting additional pressure on household budgets. An AARP report released earlier this year found that 84% of New Yorkers surveyed saw their utility bills increase over the past year, while 88% are concerned their utility costs will continue to rise.

With families looking for ways to make their dollars go further, AARP New York is helping people find affordable ways to stay engaged, connected, and active close to home through free and discounted events, classes, cultural experiences, and community activities across the state.

 Movies Turning 50: Taxi Driver

 Movies Turning 50: Taxi Driver

 📍 Bellmore, NY

New York City Council members and Borough Presidents also participated in a video series to highlight the offerings of their cities and towns. 

"As the cost of nearly everything continues to rise, a 'staycation' is a wonderful way to get out, explore, and reconnect with everything New York City has to offer without the expense and hassle of long-distance travel," said Councilmember Sandra Ung. "There are so many incredible neighborhoods to discover across our city, but you would be hard-pressed to find one with as much diversity as Flushing. From some of the best restaurants in New York City to cultural institutions like the Queens Botanical Garden, you can spend an entire day in Flushing eating, exploring, and experiencing different cultures, all without ever leaving the neighborhood. I'm proud to collaborate with AARP on this campaign and invite New Yorkers to discover just how much there is to see and do right here in our own backyard."

"Part of what makes a staycation worthwhile is having the knowledge of just how much there is to enjoy right in your own neighborhood," said Council Member Amanda Farías. "Parkchester is a Naturally Occurring Retirement Community, and for the many older New Yorkers who have built their lives there, staying active and connected should not require traveling far from home or stretching an already tight budget. We should be thinking about that same quality of life in everything we do for our aging population, from supporting the resources that allow people to age in place to making sure everyday changes in our city do not leave them behind. It is something I considered when introducing my legislation to require adequate staffing at self-checkout areas, where having an employee available to assist can make a meaningful difference for an older customer. AARP New York is helping make sure New Yorkers know what is already available to them, and I am proud to help bring that effort to Parkchester."

Manhattan Borough President Brad Hoylman-Sigal said: "You don't need a passport to find the best of everything — Manhattan is the ultimate staycation. We're the beating heart of arts, culture, finance, and leisure, all packed into 23 square miles. Catch a Tony-winning show on Broadway, lose an afternoon in Central Park, and eat your way through neighborhoods that rival any city on earth. My message to Manhattanites and visitors alike: stop scrolling for flights, everything you're looking for is already here."

Connect with AARP New York on X: @AARPNY, Facebook: AARP New York and LinkedIn: AARP New York

About AARP

AARP is the nation's largest nonprofit, nonpartisan organization dedicated to empowering Americans 50 and older to choose how they live as they age. With a nationwide presence, AARP strengthens communities and advocates for what matters most to the more than 100 million Americans 50-plus and their families: health security, financial stability and personal fulfillment. AARP also works for individuals in the marketplace by sparking new solutions and allowing carefully chosen, high-quality products and services to carry the AARP name. As a trusted source for news and information, AARP produces the nation's largest circulation publications, AARP The Magazine and AARP Bulletin. To learn more, visit www.aarp.org/about-aarp/, www.aarp.org/español or follow @AARP, @AARPenEspañol and @AARPadvocates on social media.

releases.title: Come Talk To ME, Featuring AI-Recreated Voice, Selected for Twin Cities Film Fest
releases.body:
Documentary brings Parkinson's conversations to film festivals and communities

MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Come Talk To ME, the feature-length (76 min) documentary by independent filmmaker and director Deacon Warner and first-time producer Jackie Hunt Christensen, has been selected to be part of the Twin Cities Film Fest, Oct. 15-24. The film is also currently available for community screenings worldwide through Kinema, a streaming platform that allows groups to license the film for both in-person and virtual screenings.

Come Talk To ME follows Parkinson's disease (PD) activist Jackie Hunt Christensen, her husband Paul Christensen, their two sons, and a diverse group of friends with PD. Their stories reflect on the many types of communication that are necessary to participate fully in relationships as the disease progresses.

In a groundbreaking approach, Jackie uses artificial intelligence (AI) to recreate her voice as it sounded two years after her diagnosis in 1998 but before the disease had noticeably impacted her speech. This AI-generated voice, dubbed "JHC2K," asks questions written by Jackie's present-day self and also serves as the film's narrator. 

The documentary offers an intimate look at Jackie and Paul's journey, including reflections from their two now-grown sons on how 28 years of Parkinson's have shaped their family dynamic. It also captures Jackie's behind-the-scenes efforts to produce the film, including a trip to an international summit for Parkinson's support group leaders in Austin, Texas, where she and Paul conducted interviews.

Throughout the production, Jackie and Paul face new challenges, but Jackie remains deeply committed to completing the film and raising awareness about how Parkinson's impacts communication and relationships, particularly affecting care partners.

The filmmakers are especially eager for the film to be viewed in settings that allow post-screening discussions, such as film festivals and community-hosted screenings. "I showed [Come Talk To ME] to a group of 23. Every person in the room shared that it was relevant in their life. Everyone should see this," said screening host Kari Kielblock. 

Viewer Marna Anderson described the film as, "a realistic and beautiful look at a family who is learning to love more deeply through a painful and difficult disease. It also provided excellent information and resources for viewers."

Screening Details:

Come Talk TO ME screens at 12 pm on October 24 at Edina Mann Theatre (3911 W. 50th St.

Edina, MN 55424) as part of the Twin Cities Film Fest, which runs Oct 15-24. The Twin Cities Film Fest is headquartered at Marcus West End Cinema, 1625 Park Place Blvd., St. Louis Park, MN 55416.

Anyone interested in hosting a screening of Come Talk To ME can do so directly through the film's Kinema page. Prospective hosts can also contact the film's director: director@cometalktomefilm.com

Visit the film's website to learn more about the film, find Parkinson's disease resources as well as find information about hosting a screening: cometalktomefilm.com

About the Filmmakers

Producer Jackie Hunt Christensen became a Parkinson's disease activist when she was diagnosed with the disease. She has published two guide books on the disease, The First Year---Parkinson's Disease: An Essential Guide for the Newly Diagnosed (2005) and Life With a Battery-Operated Brain: A Patient's Guide to Deep Brain Stimulation Surgery for Parkinson's Disease (2009).

At the time she was diagnosed at 34, Jackie was Co-Director of the Food and Health program at the Institute for Agriculture & Trade Policy in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as well as a co-founder and Co-Director of Health Care Without Harm (HCWH): The Campaign for Environmentally Responsible Health Care. She continued working for both organizations until June 2004, when, at age 40, her PD symptoms forced her to leave her jobs and apply for disability benefits.

Director Deacon Warner is a documentary filmmaker and youth media instructor. He has been teaching media arts since 2008. As an independent filmmaker, Deacon has directed numerous short documentaries including Bee-Sharp Honeybee, Literacy for Freedom: Empowering Black Boys in MN and Every Day Is a Parade. Deacon's first feature documentary, The Co-op Wars, premiered at the Minneapolis St Paul International Film Festival in 2021.

releases.title: Four Seasons Hotel Toronto Sets the Scene for Toronto International Film Festival's 51st Edition
releases.body:
TORONTO, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As Toronto welcomes the world's film community for the 51st edition of the Toronto International Film Festival® (TIFF), presented by Rogers, Four Seasons Hotel Toronto returns as an official hospitality partner with a curated collection of experiences inspired by the energy and glamour of Festival season. Located in the heart of Yorkville, the city's premier neighbourhood, the flagship hotel will once again serve as a sophisticated hub for filmmakers, industry leaders, tastemakers and Festivalgoers, offering exclusive events, gourmet dining, restorative wellness and a new fashion-forward activation.

"Every September, Toronto becomes one of the world's most exciting and influential cultural stages," says Chelan Goonetilleke, General Manager, Four Seasons Hotel Toronto. "We are proud to be part of that story, and to create experiences that capture the energy of the Festival, while introducing new moments of celebration, connection and discovery for our guests."

TORONTO'S MOST CELEBRATED SOCIALS

The festivities begin on September 8, with the return of the annual Festival pre-opening, Four Seasons TIFF Kick Off event at d|bar. Guests will enjoy a Signature TIFF Cocktail alongside culinary creations from Chef Pierre Boffo as the city officially kicks off the highly anticipated 10-days of film. The evening will also mark the unveiling of this year's photo exhibit in collaboration with TIFF, featuring a curated collection of Festival imagery displayed throughout the Hotel lobby and transforming the space into an immersive celebration of TIFF's rich cinematic legacy.

On September 12, Four Seasons Hotel Toronto will once again host the The Road to the 84th Golden Globes. Now in its third year at the Hotel, the invite-only event will bring together the big screen's most influential voices for an evening of cinematic celebration. 

ELEVATED DINING WITH CINEMATIC FLAIR

From September 8 to 20, guests can celebrate TIFF with a collection of culinary experiences and limited-time offerings inspired by the excitement and glamour of Festival season:

Scene-Stealing Sips at d|bar

New signature cocktails crafted with premium spirits will take centre stage at d|bar. The collection's crown jewel, the Final Cut XO Sazerac, is a showstopping tableside experience priced at $1,000. Available after 4 p.m. and offered only once per evening, the experience is available on a first-come, first-served basis and must be purchased in person at d|bar, with no advance reservations.

The cocktail includes chauffeured transportation to the guest's next downtown destination within 2 km in the Hotel's new Rolls-Royce house car, subject to availability. Should the house car be unavailable, alternate black car service can be arranged. Guests can also enjoy the Final Cut XO Sazerac without transportation at any time, delivering a truly memorable TIFF moment.

Café Boulud's Main Event

Café Boulud's signature Five-Course Tasting Menu will receive a celebratory Festival makeover. The enhanced menu by Executive Chef William Kresky will feature a dedicated caviar course and Japanese A5 Wagyu as the main course, bringing an added sense of occasion and indulgence to the dining experience.

Available for $225 per person. For reservations, visit Café Boulud.

Cinema-inspired Treats from Le Café

Inspired by classic movie-night flavours, Le Café will introduce two limited-time creations. The Popcorn Iced Latte offers a Festival pick-me-up, complemented by a Maple-Salted Popcorn Cookie, combining buttery popcorn, Canadian maple and a touch of sea salt. The pairing can be enjoyed on the go between screenings and Festival engagements or savoured in the luxurious Yorkville setting.

A Festival-Worthy Night In

Guests can bring the Festival experience to their room with an elevated movie-night package for two. For $250, the In-Room Dining experience includes Pita and House Dips, Tuna Tacos, and Truffle Fries, accompanied by Tuxedo Popcorn and a chilled bottle of Perrier-Jouët Grand Brut Champagne.

For an even more memorable experience, an optional enhancement is available including Kristal Caviar with traditional accompaniments and potato blinis.

RESTORATIVE SPA RETREATS

For those seeking relaxation between screenings and celebrations, the Spa at Four Seasons Toronto will introduce two exclusive TIFF-inspired treatments available between September 8 and September 20.

The After-Party Afterglow

This luxury experience features a 90-minute 5-in-1 Deluxe OxyGeneo Super Facial, combining exfoliation, oxygenation, serum infusion, massage and radiofrequency therapy.

Following the treatment, guests can unwind on the Cloud 9 Terrace with their choice of a green juice or Prosecco before taking home a branded Four Seasons Bath Soak and Drowsy Sleep Mask.

Starting at $755 per person. Book your appointment here.

The Red-Carpet Wind-Down

Guests can indulge in an exclusive Yorkville Manicure and Pedicure, featuring a gold-flecked scrub, warm salt stone massage, mineral mud mask and choice of buff, regular or shellac polish.

The experience concludes with a glass of Prosecco on the Cloud 9 Terrace and take-home gifts including a branded Four Seasons Bath Soak and Knesko Travel Kit including a Gold Repair Hand Mask, Foot Mask, Body Serum & Body Cream.

Starting at $595 per person. Book your appointment here.

RED CARPET STYLE, REIMAGINED

Bringing an added touch of glamour to Festival season, Four Seasons Hotel Toronto will provide guests and private residents with exclusive access to a curated collection of rare, hard-to-find luxury handbags courtesy of Zero Collective.

Starting September 8, guests can discover a coveted assortment of designer pieces from some of the world's most prestigious fashion houses, creating a personalized styling experience worthy of any premiere, celebration or red-carpet moment. Whether complementing an evening gown for a gala, accessorizing for an exclusive after-party or making a statement at a film premiere, the bespoke offering brings an added layer of sophistication and convenience to the Festival.

Stay up to date on all Four Seasons Hotel Toronto Film Festival experiences online or follow the property's official Instagram page.

About Four Seasons 

As the world's leading operator of luxury hotels, Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts manages 140 properties in 47 countries.  Open at its present location since 2012, Four Seasons Hotel Toronto is the city's premier luxury hotel located in the heart of the historic Yorkville neighborhood. The property, which completed a multimillion-dollar guest room renovation in 2024, provides a preferred address for both business and leisure travelers, and the personalized service that Four Seasons guests expect.

Four Seasons Hotel Toronto is recognized as a five-star hotel and five-star spa courtesy of the Forbes Travel Guide Star Awards and holds the Two Key distinction from the prestigious Michelin Guide. It is designated with the AAA Five Diamond Rating, as well as the Condé Nast Traveler Reader's Choice Award and Travel + Leisure World's Best Award. For more information on Four Seasons Hotel Toronto, the global flagship property, visit fourseasons.com/toronto

releases.title: Over 250 Full Sail University graduates contributed to more than 200 nominated projects at the 78th annual Primetime Emmy Awards
releases.body:
17 Full Sail alumni nominated for a total of 20 Primetime Emmy Awards of their very own

WINTER PARK, Fla., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Full Sail University, an award-winning educational leader for those pursuing careers in entertainment media and emerging technologies is proud to share that over 250 alumni are credited on more than 200 nominated projects across 104 categories at the 78th annual Primetime Emmy Awards. Hosted by Mariska Hargitay, the ceremony will be broadcast live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, California on Monday, September 14, 2026.

Over 250 Full Sail grads credited on over 200 nominated projects across 104 categories at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards

"Our graduates are making their mark on some of the most compelling projects in television and media today, and we could not be prouder," said Garry Jones, President of Full Sail University. "Their contributions to this year's Primetime Emmy-nominated productions reflect the creativity, talent and determination they honed during their time at Full Sail. We celebrate this not only as a testament to their individual accomplishments, but also as a reflection of the extraordinary impact our graduates are having across the entertainment industry. Their success serves to inspire the next generation of students to dream boldly while pursuing their craft."  

This year, 17 Full Sail graduates were nominated for Primetime Emmy Awards of their very own, working in producing, sound design, sound mixing, and more.

Individually nominated Full Sail University graduates include:

Outstanding Guest Actress In A Drama Series

  • Tal Anderson - Guest Actress as Becca King - The Pitt - 5:00 P.M.

Outstanding Limited or Anthology Series

  • Sean Sforza - Producer - The Beast In Me
  • Eric Kovtun - Executive Producer - Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette

Outstanding Picture Editing For A Structured Reality or Competition Program

  • Michelle Ivan - Editor - The Amazing Race

Outstanding Sound Editing For A Comedy Or Drama Series (Half-Hour) And Animation

  • James Miller - Sound Designer - Predator: Killer of Killers

Outstanding Sound Editing For A Comedy Or Drama Series (One Hour)

  • Brad North - Co-Supervising Sound Editor - Alien: Earth - Neverland
  • Andy Sisal - Co-Supervising Sound Editor/Sound Designer - Spider-Noir - The Man In The Mask

Outstanding Sound Editing For A Limited Or Anthology Series, Movie or Special

  • Ruy Garcia - Supervising Sound Editor - The Beast In Me - Sick Puppy
  • Jerry Lafuente - Sound Effects Editor - Beef - It Will Stay This Way And You Will Obey

Outstanding Sound Editing For A Nonfiction Or Reality Program

  • Debora Lilavois - Music Editor - Billy Joel: And So It Goes

Outstanding Sound Mixing For A Comedy Or Drama Series (One Hour)

  • Judah Getz - Adr Mixer - Pluribus - We Is Us
  • Michael P. Clark - Re-recording Mixer - Stranger Things - Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up

Outstanding Sound Mixing For A Limited Or Anthology Series Or Movie

  • Judah Getz - Adr Mixer - Beef - It Will Stay This Way And You Will Obey
  • Jamison Rabbe - Adr Mixer - Monster: The Ed Gein Story - Sick As Your Secrets

Outstanding Sound Mixing For A Comedy Or Drama Series (Half-Hour) And Animation

  • Patrick Christensen - Adr Mixer - The Bear - Scallop
  • Jamison Rabbe - Adr Mixer - Shrinking - I Will Be Grape
  • Jeffrey Roy - Adr Mixer - Shrinking - I Will Be Grape
  • Judah Getz - Adr Mixer - Widow's Bay - What To Expect On Your Trip

Outstanding Sound Mixing For A Nonfiction Program

  • Gary A. Rizzo - Re-recording Mixer - John Candy: I Like Me

Outstanding Sound Mixing For A Reality Program

  • John A. Pitron - Production Mixer - The Amazing Race

Full Sail graduates have contributed to notable projects across major streaming platforms and networks including Netflix, HBO Max, Hulu, Apple TV, Disney+, ABC, CBS, NBC, FX, Prime Video, Peacock, and more. To learn more about Full Sail visit fullsail.edu.

About Full Sail University:

Full Sail University is an award-winning educational leader for those pursuing careers in entertainment media and emerging technologies. Founded in 1979, Full Sail has received numerous accolades throughout its over 45-year history, including most recently being named a 2026 "Top Game Design School" by The Princeton Review and one of "The 30 Best Film Schools in the U.S. and Canada" in 2026 by MovieMaker Magazine. Full Sail University is a graduate and undergraduate degree-granting institution offering on-campus and online degree programs in areas related to Art & Design, Business, Film & Television, Games, Media & Communications, Music & Recording, Sports, and Technology. With over 100,000 graduates worldwide, Full Sail alumni have worked on countless award-winning projects with individual recognition including Oscar®, Emmy®, Grammy®, Addy® and The Game Award honors.

Contact: Casey Tanous, Ctanous@fullsail.edu. 407-310-2497

releases.title: CJ 4DPLEX and B&B Theatres Strengthen Partnership with New 4DX and SCREENX Experiences at Liberty Township, Ohio
releases.body:
Newly opened Ohio expansion features B&B's first multisensory 4DX auditorium in the state, Ohio's largest SCREENX 270-degree panoramic auditorium, and North America's first SCREENX with Dolby Atmos

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CJ 4DPLEX, the world's leading producer of premium cinema formats and immersive theater experiences, and B&B Theatres, the fifth-largest theatre chain in America, announced today the opening of a new 4DX auditorium and SCREENX auditorium enhanced by Dolby Atmos at B&B Theatres Liberty Township in Butler County, Ohio.

The new experiences, which opened to moviegoers last Friday, represent several meaningful milestones for CJ 4DPLEX. SCREENX arrives in the Cincinnati market for the first time, becoming the fifth installation in Ohio and the fifteenth across B&B Theatres' growing portfolio of premium cinematic experiences. Situated within B&B's Grand Screen PLF auditorium, the 270-degree format expands across a sweeping 57-foot-wide screen with 198 recliner seats, making it the largest SCREENX auditorium in Ohio and one of the most striking SCREENX cinematic spaces in the country.

The 98-seat 4DX auditorium is equally significant, marking the multisensory format's debut in Ohio and the second developed alongside B&B Theatres. Together, the two formats under one roof represent the latest milestone in CJ 4DPLEX and B&B Theatres' expanding partnership and shared commitment to elevating the moviegoing experience.

SCREENX introduces a 270-degree panoramic viewing environment that expands select scenes of a film beyond the main screen and onto the auditorium's side walls, surrounding audiences and placing them directly inside the story. At Liberty Township, that visual immersion is matched by the power of Dolby Atmos, a revolutionary spatial audio technology that moves beyond the traditional surround sound experience.

4DX takes the experience a step further by synchronizing motion seats and environmental effects, including wind, vibration, lightning, scent and water, with the action on screen, allowing audiences to feel the film as it unfolds.

"Our relationship with B&B Theatres continues to reach new heights, and the Liberty Township location is a testament to what we can accomplish together," said Don Savant, CEO and President, Americas at CJ 4DPLEX. "Every new opening reflects our shared vision of expanding premium cinema experiences, and bringing the first SCREENX with Dolby Atmos in the United States to this market is another exciting milestone."

"SCREENX and 4DX represent the spirit of innovation that has guided B&B for over a hundred years," said Brock Bagby, President of B&B Theatres. "We are committed to creating venues that feature the best entertainment in the marketplace, and CJ 4DPLEX has been an incredible partner in the realization of that vision. We are thrilled to bring these experiences to Liberty Township."

CJ 4DPLEX and B&B Theatres first joined forces in 2018, and their premium cinema footprint has grown steadily ever since. Liberty Township is their fourteenth SCREENX and second 4DX location together and reinforces both companies' long-term commitment to growing premium cinema together.

Home to Ohio's largest SCREENX auditorium and North America's first SCREENX with Dolby Atmos, alongside Ohio's first 4DX theater, B&B Theatres Liberty Township is located at 7514 Bales St., Liberty Township, OH 45069. Both experiences are now open to moviegoers. Tickets can be purchased at bbtheatres.com.

About CJ 4DPLEX

CJ 4DPLEX is a proud subsidiary of CJ Group, Korea's leading lifestyle and culture company. Headquartered in Sangam, Seoul, we design and develop immersive cinema technologies that inspire audiences worldwide. Guided by creativity, technology and cultural vision, we are committed to redefining the future of cinema starting right here in Korea.

CJ 4DPLEX is redefining the moviegoing experience across many countries worldwide, working with the world's top exhibitors to deliver SCREENX, 4DX and ULTRA 4DX to audiences everywhere. From the United States to Europe, Asia and the Middle East, our global presence keeps growing, driven by our mission to make immersive storytelling the standard in cinema. Innovation drives us to connect people beyond language and borders through shared experiences.

CJ 4DPLEX can be found at www.cj4dplex.com.

About 4DX

4DX provides a synesthetic viewing experience that connects audiences with movies through its state-of-the-art motion seats and 21 environmental effects that include water, wind and scents. The 4DX theater allows audiences to experience environmental effects such as wind, light, fog, fragrance and vibration, as well as motion chairs that move in synchronization with scenes in the movie. Audiences can experience a new level of immersion that extends beyond traditional video and sound.

About SCREENX

SCREENX is the world's most immersive platform, breaking free from the boundaries of a single screen to place audiences at the heart of the story.

With visuals flowing seamlessly across the walls, SCREENX connects film and space, creating moments of natural immersion. Every sequence is curated to reflect the director's vision, turning each film into a journey only SCREENX can deliver.

About B&B Theatres

B&B Theatres has been family owned and operated since 1924, when Elmer Bills Sr. opened a movie house in Salisbury, Missouri, where the future Mrs. Bills played the piano for silent movies. Across more than a century and four generations of family involvement, the company has seen the arrival of sound, color, Technicolor, stadium seating, multiplexes, recliners and digital cinema. B&B Theatres is the fifth-largest theatre chain in America and operates approximately 517 screens at 54 locations across the United States.

releases.title: Created in LA Announces New Speakers and Programming Details Featuring Dhar Mann, Dude Perfect, The Try Guys, Asad Ayaz, Jared Bush and More as Sticks Makes History at El Capitan Theatre
releases.body:
Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro to welcome creators to the Walt Disney Studios lot; President and Chief Creative Officer Dana Walden to deliver opening night remarks

BURBANK, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Disney and creator Jon Youshaei announced additional speakers for Created in LA, adding Dude Perfect, The Try Guys, Jordan Matter, Adrian Per, Dhar Mann, and Oscar-winning Chief Creative Officer of Walt Disney Animation Studios Jared Bush to the lineup. The announcement also includes new programming details for Chief Marketing and Brand Officer of The Walt Disney Company Asad Ayaz. They join previously announced speakers including Zach King, AdamW, Jenny Hoyos and Sam Eckholm.

Created in LA will open on September 17 with a red-carpet premiere highlighted by the debut of an original video from Sticks on the El Capitan Theatre's big screen. Titled "The Technoblade Movie," the project serves as a tribute to one of the most beloved creators. Sticks is a filmmaking and digital creator duo with 1.2M in social reach that has emerged as a rising voice in the next generation of creator-led entertainment. The screening marks the first time in the theater's 100-year history that it will host a premiere of this kind.

Dana Walden, President and Chief Creative Officer of The Walt Disney Company, will kick off the creator premiere at the El Capitan Theatre on September 17. On September 18, Chief Executive Officer of The Walt Disney Company, Josh D'Amaro, will take the stage at the Walt Disney Studios lot, gathering storytellers at the place where Walt Disney's vision of creativity and innovation all started.

New Speakers and Session Details

Adrian Per | Outsmart the Algorithm: More Content, Less Burnout

As one of Instagram's Top 25 creators in 2025, Adrian Per has been praised by Instagram CEO Adam Mosseri as "one of the most influential creators on the platform." In this talk presented by Adobe, Adrian gives a masterclass on his creative process, how to be original, and increase your quantity of posts without losing quality or burning out.

Asad Ayaz | Your Next Big Project with Disney

Most creators have bigger ambitions than their next upload. They want to direct a feature, star in a series, build a world that outlives the channel. Asad Ayaz, Chief Marketing and Brand Officer of The Walt Disney Company, will show the real paths creators are taking into Disney right now — scripted series, features, brand campaigns — and how creators can take their content to another level with Disney, too.

Dhar Mann | From Script to Screen: Inside Dhar Mann's Creative Process

Few creators are as prolific as Dhar Mann. In his 125,000-square-foot studio, he has over 65 sets and 10 crews filming at once to post five TV-length videos per week. It's a scaled machine unlike any other on YouTube, dedicated to uplifting the world by creating stories and experiences that help people feel seen and connected. In this session, Dhar breaks down how he went from filming videos in a studio apartment to building his own studio — and exactly how he takes a video from script to screen.

Dude Perfect | How to Build Your "Perfect" Team: 17 Years, 62M Subs, Same Dudes

Whether it's your next collab or co-founder you'll create with, finding the right people is everything. Dude Perfect knows that better than anyone. After 17 years, they're still growing — 62 million subscribers, $100M investment, and an 80,000 square foot HQ. Join the Dudes — Cory Cotton and Garrett Hilbert as they break down their biggest moments, most crucial decisions, and how they split up roles to build one of YouTube's biggest channels—and companies.

Jared Bush | Storytelling Spontaneity: When to Throw Out Good Ideas for Great Ones

Chief Creative Officer for Walt Disney Animation Studios Jared Bush has written or directed many beloved blockbusters, including Moana, Encanto, Zootopia, and more. He'll break down his storytelling process, what actually happens behind the scenes, and how to pursue great ideas.

Jordan Matter | Winning IRL: Why 87,000 Fans Came to Our Event

Jordan didn't get to 37 million subscribers by posting more. He posted differently. Together with his daughter Salish, they get 390 million longform views a month and brought 87,000 fans to their meetup — the biggest creator event in North American history. In this session, he walks through the rules and tips they follow to turn views into true fans and customers.

The Try Guys | How to Make Shows, Not Just Videos

Most creators just make videos But the Try Guys make great shows: Eat the Menu, Without a Recipe, Killer Dinner and more. With over 5 billion views and 12 years of experience, Zach and Keith break down their creative process step-by-step so any creator can apply to their content.

About Created in LA

Created in LA is an exclusive two-day experience created by Jon Youshaei and presented by Disney that brings together some of the world's top creators for a first-of-its kind program exploring the future of content, influence and storytelling. For more information visit [insert TWDC blog post link] and https://created.la/

About The Walt Disney Company 

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international entertainment and media enterprise that includes three business segments: Entertainment, Sports, and Experiences. Disney is a Dow 30 company and had annual revenue of $94.4 billion in its Fiscal Year 2025.

releases.title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Harbinger Arrives with the Deadly Eidolon Faction
releases.body:
Expansion launches along with the free version 2.0 update which includes new units, improved graphics, updated market view, new VO and more

Harbinger Expansion Trailer: https://youtu.be/tTMjpY2LAAs 

PLYMOUTH, Mich., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Stardock today released the first expansion for Sins of a Solar Empire II, Harbinger. The new DLC adds the long-awaited fourth faction to the Sins universe, giving a face to the great enemy that's chased the Vasari for 10,000 years. The expansion is available now on Steam, Epic Games Store, and direct through Stardock with a launch discount price of $23.99. Shipping alongside Harbinger is a free version 2.0 update for every Sins of a Solar Empire II owner.

The Eidolon

Fighting for planets, trade routes, culture, or wealth is not the Eidolon way. Working behind the scenes, the Eidolon spread corruption wherever they go. Their technology shrouds entire worlds to fuel their advance, and they strike from the shadows with cloaked fleets, forcing every other empire to fight for survival on unfamiliar terms. 

Expansion Features 

The Eidolon rewrite the rules of galactic conquest with systems built around corruption, secrecy, and control: 

  • Planetary Transformation: The Eidolon spread corruption across the galaxy to empower themselves and their worlds. As populations fall under the Eidolon's influence, their planets gain corruption over time. Once a world has fully fallen, it can be shrouded, greatly expanding the upgrades that planet can support.



  • Unit Corruption: Corruption empowers Eidolon units in combat as well as weakens them. As an Eidolon ship gains corruption, its hull dwindles while its offensive power increases. Enemy forces can become infected by corruption, giving the Eidolon another advantage.



  • Null Weapons: Eidolon weapons are far more advanced than the other factions, and can negate shields and spread corruption against enemies.



  • Cloaked Ships: Subterfuge is one of the sharpest weapons of a great enemy, as on the Kalizaeth Profaner support capital ship. New cloaking and detection systems let the Eidolon appear and vanish at will, enabling hit-and-run tactics that reward patience and punish anyone caught off guard. 



  • Psionic Abilities: The Eidolon possess psionic abilities that allow them to seize control of lesser beings and drive Vasari ships into madness, firing on friend and foe alike. 



  • Phase Echoes: Sometimes the dead don't die. Eidolon units infused with corruption may refuse to die and carry on the onslaught. 

Version 2.0 Features

  • Quality of Life UX Improvements
    • Updated Unity quick bar system can now expand and be pinned.
    • Weapon ranges of defense structures are now visible on mouseover and during placement.
    • Market window has been redesigned and now uses price fluctuations with tracking and price history.
    • Improved tooltips that give more information on why you can't do something.
  • Updated Mod UI
    • Redesigned the Modding UI system to make it easier to browse collections and highlight popular mods.
    • Users can now save playlists of mods and reload them. The game will automatically offer to download mods that aren't installed.
    • Added more filtering options and various safeguards during installation (e.g., low disk space, etc.).
  • Updated Graphics Settings
    • New planetary shaders provide more natural lighting and weather effects.
    • Improved threading system helps prevent crashes or hangs on systems with low texture memory.
    • The game now auto-detects which graphics settings are best for your system.

Sins of a Solar Empire II: Harbinger is now available to play on Steam, Epic Games Store, or direct through Stardock with a launch discount price of $23.99 through September 14 at 1:00 PM ET. The expansion is also included as part of the Premium Edition for $99.99 or as part of the Sins of a Solar Empire II: Content Pass for $59.99. The free v2.0 base-game update has also been released simultaneously to all Sins of a Solar Empire II owners on all platforms. Follow Sins II and learn more at https://www.sinsofasolarempire2.com.

About Stardock Entertainment 

Stardock is a pioneer in the strategy gaming genre headquartered in Plymouth, Mich. that has been developing and publishing strategy and simulation games since 1993, starting with the original release of Galactic Civilizations. Stardock's recent hits include Sins of a Solar Empire, Ashes of the Singularity, Elemental: Reforged, and Offworld Trading Company. Learn more at https://www.stardock.com.
